# sortSheets

<link-summary>Reorders the tabs of a spreadsheet.</link-summary>

<web-summary>sortSheets() — Reorders the tabs of a spreadsheet. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.5.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function sortSheets(
  spreadsheet: GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Spreadsheet,
  callback?: (a: string, b: string) => number
): void;
```

By name, ascending, unless a comparison function is given — it receives two sheet names and works like the one `Array#sort` takes.

The tabs are moved one at a time, and each move is a call to the service, so a spreadsheet with many sheets takes a moment.

## Parameters

| Parameter               | Type                                       | Description                                        |
| :---------------------- | :----------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------- |
| `spreadsheet`           | `GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Spreadsheet` | The spreadsheet whose tabs are reordered.          |
| `callback` _(optional)_ | `(a: string, b: string) => number`         | Compares two sheet names, as `Array#sort` expects. |

## Returns

`void` — nothing; the spreadsheet is changed in place.

## Examples

### Sorting the tabs

```javascript
const spreadsheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActive();

sortSheets(spreadsheet); // alphabetically by name

sortSheets(spreadsheet, (a, b) => b.localeCompare(a)); // reversed
```
